source: forwardProxyTLSCustomTrustX509Certificates is read with x509ChainFromPEMFile, i.e. its bytes go into CertificateFactory.generateCertificates, so a CA file in BER with indefinite lengths (on the certificate and its TBSCertificate) is trusted: an https forward under CUSTOM trust reaches a peer serving a leaf that CA signed (tests/files/x509/forward-trust/gen.sh)

steps.note: the upstream's chain is trusted: its answer comes back
